# Leaflet 1.9.4

Unmodified Leaflet distribution files, self-hosted for the session planner.

Source: https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/

The accompanying LICENSE is from https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/LICENSE.
The images and source map are included because the distribution's CSS and
JavaScript reference them. Delivery and pickup pins use the planner's own code.
